source_text: Aaron occurrit Moysi in monte Dei — os aperitur ei qui in monte occurrit. Nisi montem legis spiritalis adscenderis, os non aperit Dominus. Ingressi ad Pharaonem: Dimitte populum meum ut serviat mihi in eremo. Non in Aegypto servire, sed via trium dierum in eremo. Exeundum de mundo animo non loco; nolite diligere mundum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Aaron meets Moses on mountain of-God — mouth is-opened to-him who on mountain meets. Unless mountain of-law spiritual you-ascend, mouth not opens Lord. Having-entered to Pharaoh: Send-away people my that it-may-serve me in desert. Not in Egypt to-serve, but way of-three days in desert. To-be-exited from world by-mind not by-place; do-not love world. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Aaron met Moses on the mountain of God >> Bible:Exodus 4:27]] — the mouth God opens belongs to whoever can meet there. Unless you climb the spiritual sense of the Law, you have not met Moses on that mountain, and God has not opened your mouth. When Moses and Aaron enter to Pharaoh they say: [[Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness >> Bible:Exodus 5:1]] — not serve while still in Egypt’s dark business, for [[no one can serve two masters >> Bible:Luke 16:13]]. Leave the world in mind, not merely in place; [[do not love the world >> Bible:1 John 2:15]]. The [[three days’ journey >> Bible:Exodus 3:18]] marks the way. Amen.
